trigger_conditions: Generating random port numbers without checking configuration.
Invoking 'standard' algorithms (e.g., Solfeggio frequencies) instead of reading project math logic.
Assuming an API endpoint exists without checking the routing files.

mitigation_strategies.variable_names: Must be copy-pasted or strictly verified via search, never generated from memory.
mitigation_strategies.file_paths: Always use absolute paths derived from list_dir or find.
mitigation_strategies.third_party_libraries: Do not invoke library methods unless verifying they exist in the currently installed version.
